gen-silkscreen-gf-red-hat-text: Silkscreen spaces its letters out like spaghetti laid in rows. Red Hat Text follows in a plain sans with thin, technical-pen lines and curvy shapes, so the blocky heading gets a softer, more modern partner underneath.
gen-silkscreen-gf-reddit-sans: Lo-fi and a bit retro, Silkscreen leaves space you can almost feel around each letter. Reddit Sans takes over below in a plain sans of uniform stroke and open e terminals, so extended paragraphs would glide along without any fuss.
gen-silkscreen-gf-rethink-sans: Generous gaps around every letter give Silkscreen its pixel-built, retro signature. And Rethink Sans keeps its openings wide at every weight, so a long stretch of text would feel approachable and easy to settle into.
gen-silkscreen-gf-roboto-flex: Retro, blocky and a little lo-fi, all in one flat line weight. But Roboto Flex has a wide slot between the c's ends, so if the heading shrank or the sans-serif body grew, the roles would start to blur.
gen-silkscreen-gf-rosario: Chunky, retro bowls with no thinning at the sides. Rosario sits beneath in a plain sans whose c never curls inward, which gives the heading's rigid grid a friendlier, contemporary voice to talk over.
gen-silkscreen-gf-ruluko: Round letters, walls as heavy as the straight ones. Silkscreen is best at stamping out a lo-fi retro mood, while Ruluko is the sans for broad, open counters on c and s that read comfortably.
gen-silkscreen-gf-sansation: Approachable, despite its retro pixel-grid stiffness. Silkscreen does best with unmodulated, spaced-out display lettering, whereas Sansation is the sans that lets curves turn in smoothly without any ink pooling.
gen-silkscreen-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Silkscreen draws round bowls whose outlines never swell or thin, giving every heading a lo-fi, retro stamp. Sawarabi Gothic answers in a plain sans with open jaws on its curves.
gen-silkscreen-gf-shanti: Curves that match the stems exactly give Silkscreen its lo-fi, retro, spaghetti-in-rows look. Shanti steps in below as a plain sans with a generous entry into the e's eye, modern and professional.
gen-silkscreen-gf-shippori-antique: Contemporary and a touch retro, Silkscreen spaces its letters with room you can nearly feel. But Shippori Antique, with its monoweight skeleton and open bowls tipped like a ladle, would carry a long passage smoothly.
